doc.title: Iola Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, CT, July 17, 2011

title: Smithsonian omissions of Dave
summary: Blue Rondo is on the Smithsonian collection but Dave was left out of the Jazz Anthology and Piano Anthology.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: And just recently of course “Blue Rondo” is included on the Smithsonian’s Jazz CD collection. They chose that particular tune too.

Right. That again was one of those things. I was glad that we lived long enough to see that omission of Dave from the Smithsonian Jazz Anthology — it was incredible. And when that happened I said well, okay, they have to cover so many years, maybe that’s forgivable. Then came the Jazz Piano Anthology. He wasn’t in that one. Wait a minute. That isn’t even accurate history. Whether you like that style of piano or not, if you’re going to compile something that is supposed to be jazz history that just is not right.
